items.description: Introduction provides sufficient background to understand the problem. Problem statement is articulated clearly. Stakeholders are correctly identified. Deliverables are realistic, and the system is well-scoped.

goodLevelRequirements.description: Introduction provides sufficient background to understand the problem. Problem statement is articulated clearly. Stakeholders are correctly identified. Deliverables are realistic, and the system is well-scoped.

averageLevelRequirements.description: Introduction and deliverables are reasonably described, but may include some uncertainty that requires further clarification.

poorLevelRequirements.description: Introduction provides insufficient background for understanding the current problem, problem statement is vague or stakeholders are missing or incorrectly identified. Deliverables and scope do not align with the stakeholder expectations.

items.description: Methodology is clear and the milestones are properly thought out. Work breakdown clearly identifies activities to be carried out and roles of team members are clear with communication processes in place for coordinating work. Risk properly analyzed and managed with clear mitigation strategies.

goodLevelRequirements.description: Methodology is clear and the milestones are properly thought out. Work breakdown clearly identifies activities to be carried out and roles of team members are clear with communication processes in place for coordinating work. Risk properly analyzed and managed with clear mitigation strategies.

averageLevelRequirements.description: Methodology is identified and milestones set are reasonable. Work breakdown is present with roles and communication medium is agreed upon. Risk management analysis is conducted with some mitigation strategies in place.

poorLevelRequirements.description: Planning is incomplete, with unrealistic milestones, incomplete work breakdown and missing project roles. No clear communication process in place and risk is not properly managed.

items.description: Requirements are comprehensive with all relevant user stories identified and correctly translated into use cases. Non-functional requirements are clearly specified along with the criteria used to measure them. Constraints are properly thought out and reflects the real-world scenario.

goodLevelRequirements.description: Requirements are comprehensive with all relevant user stories identified and correctly translated into use cases. Non-functional requirements are clearly specified along with the criteria used to measure them. Constraints are properly thought out and reflects the real-world scenario.
keyDeliverables: Complete user stories with acceptance criteria

averageLevelRequirements.description: Requirements covers the necessary user stories and use cases for the system to meet the client's requirements. Non-functional requirements are reasonable but may not include specifics for how to measure them. Constraints are considered and itemized.

poorLevelRequirements.description: Requirements are incomplete or misaligned with missing user stories or use cases necessary for the system to fully function. Non-functional requirements are missing or do not align with the stakeholder requirements. Missing constraints or constraints are not related to the stakeholder requirements.
keyDeliverables: Missing user stories or use cases
